lines.zh: 我的鳞片是黑的，会反光。
lines.en: My scales are black and reflective.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，但我不会碎。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but I never shatter.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲是我的家。
lines.en: The basalt deltas are my home.

lines.zh: 我划过岩浆，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: I cut through lava without a sound.

lines.zh: 别碰我的壳，边缘很锋利。
lines.en: Don't touch my shell, its edges are sharp.
I travel along the rock floor, steady.

lines.zh: 我的重量让我沉在下面。
lines.en: My weight keeps me low in the flow.

lines.zh: 这道沟太浅了，我过不去。
lines.en: This channel is too shallow for me.

lines.zh: 黑石在我身边排成一堵墙。
lines.en: Black stone lines up like a wall beside me.

lines.zh: 我每划一下鳍都很费力。
lines.en: Every fin stroke costs me effort.

lines.zh: 前面那块碎黑曜石，我认得。
lines.en: That broken obsidian ahead, I know it.

lines.zh: 我身上有一层冷却的壳。
lines.en: A cooled shell coats my body.
Don't go far, I can't keep up.
I'll just shift over there, slowly.

lines.zh: 岩浆在我身下流，像稠的糖。
lines.en: Lava flows under me like thick syrup.

lines.zh: 我擦过一块黑石，留下浅浅的白印。
lines.en: I graze a blackstone, leaving a pale score.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候像一块石头。
lines.en: When I hold still, I look like stone.
Lava slides off my shell.

lines.zh: 我的护甲今天有点发灰。
lines.en: My armor looks a bit gray today.

lines.zh: 玄武岩的柱子一根根立着。
lines.en: The basalt columns stand one by one.

lines.zh: 有人会把我当成矿石吧。
lines.en: Someone might mistake me for ore.
I needn't move, waiting is enough.
My edges have gone a little dull.
This lava is calm today.

lines.zh: 我在听岩石裂开的声音。
lines.en: I'm listening to the rock crack.
I'm hungry, but I can endure it.
Ash settles on my shell and hides the shine.
My kin drift slowly in the distance.
I try to sharpen my edge.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我更像黑曜石。
lines.en: In stillness I resemble obsidian more.
Your sword won't cut me.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，像在看矿石。
lines.en: You look at me like I'm ore.
Your pickaxe is still raised.
Don't strike me, you'll chip your blade.
I look up only because moving is a bother.

lines.zh: 你在看我这身黑壳，对吧。
lines.en: You are staring at my black shell, aren't you.
Do you want obsidian, or me?
My armor is thicker than yours.
Step back and I'll relax.
Have you looked long enough?
Basalt grit scrapes against my scales.
Hitting me doesn't hurt, it's just loud.
Your blow rattled my head.

lines.zh: 我的鳞比玄武岩还硬，可惜有缝。
lines.en: My scales are harder than basalt, but they have seams.
Fragments fell into the lava.
My armor took most of it.

lines.zh: 这一下打到了我的软处。
lines.en: That one found my soft spot.
I'm backing away, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的壳在响，像石头裂开。
lines.en: My shell creaks like splitting stone.
Even hardness has its limits.
Smells of obsidian? No, not quite.
That piece in your hand, I want it.
The bait is too soft for my taste.
I drift over slowly, no hurry.
Don't wiggle it, I see it clearly.
That piece could patch my shell.

lines.zh: 黑曜石鳞片挡着，熔岩也烫不熟我。
lines.en: Obsidian scales keep even lava from cooking me.
The line scraped my armor.
I want to bite, but first I must turn.
This is mine, let go.
Hitting me doesn't hurt me, it hurts you.
You stepped on me and I didn't budge.
Don't kick me, you'll cut yourself.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，发出铁一样的声音。
lines.en: We collided with a sound like iron.
I'm too heavy to push.
This crack can't fit my shell.
You're stuck on me, sorry.

lines.zh: 我滚了一圈，还是那么硬。
lines.en: I rolled once and stayed just as hard.
Move, I brake slowly.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片划破了你的袖子。
lines.en: My scales tore your sleeve.
Side by side, we look like two black stones.
Your shell shines more than mine.
Slow down, neither of us moves fast.

lines.zh: 玄武岩深处没人来打扰。
lines.en: Nobody comes deep into the basalt.
I blunt my edges for you.
Let's sink to the rock floor together.
Your armor has a few cracks.

lines.zh: 以后你挡前面，我挡后面。
lines.en: You take the front, I'll take the back.

lines.zh: 这块黑曜石，我磨了很久。
lines.en: I polished this obsidian a long while.
Don't rub against me, bits will flake.
I pin it down with my shell.
Too heavy? Just right for me.
It's wedged between my scales.
I lift it slowly in my mouth.
This black stone is mine now.

lines.zh: 掉进岩浆？它也沉不下去。
lines.en: Into the lava? It won't even sink.
My mouth isn't large enough.

lines.zh: 黑曜石的鳞，是我先看见的。
lines.en: Those obsidian scales, I saw them first.
It polished my shell brighter.
I can't carry it, so I push with my head.
The rock shakes, something's coming.
My armor tightened on its own.
It crushed a piece of basalt.
An unfamiliar smell, not fish.
I turn slowly to look.

lines.zh: 它的影子挡住了岩浆的光。
lines.en: Its shadow blocked the lava's glow.
Bigger than me, but I'm harder.
I press my body flat to the rock.
It's still coming closer.
I'll let it strike first.
I don't chase, I let it come to me.
My shell is my weapon.
It circles; I stay put.
Its joints look the softest.
I turn so my edge faces out.

lines.zh: 近了，我能听见它的呼吸。
lines.en: Close now, I can hear it breathe.

lines.zh: 这一下要撞在它的手腕上。
lines.en: This one goes for its wrist.
It hesitated, so I go first.

lines.zh: 我的重量是最好的筹码。
lines.en: My weight is my best advantage.
Wait, let it take one more step.
I slam my whole body into it.

lines.zh: 我的边切开了它的护甲。
lines.en: My edge split its armor open.
It struck me and sparks flew.
I won't back off, retreat loses.
That hit rang through my shell.
Its blade chipped at the edge.
Blood became red mist in the lava.
I pin it so it can't move.

lines.zh: 我又慢又重，你可想清楚。
lines.en: I'm slow and heavy, think carefully.

lines.zh: 这一击我留着最后一分力。
lines.en: I'm saving my last bit of strength.

lines.zh: 我从冷却的岩浆里凝出来。
lines.en: I condense out of cooling lava.
My shell is soft; I must wait for it to harden.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，我又回来了。
lines.en: Basalt deltas, I'm back again.
I open my eyes to black stone everywhere.
My first breath was scorching.

lines.zh: 同伴们已经在岩底等着。
lines.en: My kin are already waiting on the rock floor.
I sink down slowly.

lines.zh: 这块岩壁正好当我的靠背。
lines.en: This wall will do as my backing.
I try moving my fins.
It cools fast, and hardens just as fast.
Fire slid right off my shell.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆面摔下，壳上多一道裂。
lines.en: I drop off the lava's surface; a new crack in my shell.

lines.zh: 水浸透了我壳缝里的灰。
lines.en: Water soaked the ash in my cracks.

lines.zh: 岩浆里也被炸得翻了个身。
lines.en: Even in lava, the blast flipped me over.
The arrow struck my shell and bounced off.

lines.zh: 这股力量穿过了我的壳。
lines.en: This force went straight through my shell.
Hunger is thinning my shell.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的壳走到岩浆里。
lines.en: Lightning ran down my shell into the lava.
I'm falling and my shell is going cold.
